facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa describes the Technological New Deal as a strategic programme whose key objectives include digitizing 90% of public services by 2034, training 100,000 digital experts, creating tech centres of excellence and securing sensitive data in Senegal; no cost is given.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Affairs (Minister Alioune Sall)

note: Standing and period not stated in this article (it calls the New Deal a strategic programme outlining the digital vision, to structure the digital sector and centralize technology governance).
